entries.summary: Implemented per-user GitHub video segmentation with per-course repos. YouTube-like video player with streaming proxy, preloading, interactive questions with AI explanations.
entries.details: New model: GitHubAccount (user, github_username, github_token). VideoQuestion model with timestamp, question_type, options, correct_answer. VideoQuestionAttempt model for user answers. API: GET/POST /courses/lessons/{id}/questions/, POST /courses/questions/{id}/answer/, POST /courses/questions/{id}/explain/. VideoPlayer.tsx shows questions at timestamps, pauses video, accepts answers, shows correct/wrong feedback, AI explanation for wrong answers, retry option.
entries.code:
POST /api/courses/github/ {github_username, github_token}
DELETE /api/courses/github/
GET /api/courses/{id}/github/ - returns repo_url, lessons, segments
POST /api/courses/video-upload/ {file, lesson_id, segment_duration}
GET /api/courses/stream/{segment_id}/ - streams video from GitHub
GET /api/courses/lessons/{id}/questions/ - list questions
POST /api/courses/questions/{id}/answer/ - submit answer
POST /api/courses/questions/{id}/explain/ - get AI explanation for wrong answer
decisions: Each course gets its own repo: aura-course-{course-slug}
Each lesson is a folder: lesson-{id}-{title}
User can override segment_duration via API (30-3600 seconds)
YouTube-like player with auto-play, progress bar, chapters sidebar
Streaming proxy fetches from GitHub on-demand, no local storage
Loading indicator shows when fetching from GitHub
Preload next segment 10 seconds before current ends
Questions appear at specific timestamps, video pauses
AI agent explains wrong answers with retry option
